svg.title: The region inside r = 2 + 2 cos θ and outside r = 3
svg.desc: The cardioid r = 2 + 2 cos θ in emerald and the circle r = 3 in blue on a polar grid. They meet at (3, π/3) and (3, −π/3), marked with dashed rays from the pole. The region inside the cardioid and outside the circle, a crescent on the right, is shaded. A side panel gives the steps: set 2 + 2 cos θ = 3 to get θ = ±π/3; on that interval the cardioid is the outer curve; the area is one half the integral from −π/3 to π/3 of (2 + 2 cos θ) squared minus 3 squared, which is (9√3 − 2π)/2, about 4.653.

text.tspan: Inside the cardioid, outside the circle
2 + 2 cos θ = 3, so cos θ = ½
2. Which is farther from the pole?
